frozenInputVerification.appPathsDiffAgainstSource: EMPTY: apps packages scripts package.json package-lock.json

requirements.detail: All existing qualification commands retained. Size uses strict positive decimal local docker.image.Size; exact boundary passes, malformed/overlimit/inspect failure aborts before ECR authentication or push. Shared command failure propagation preserved.

New runner is embedded with SHA256 verification into inline buildspec and written outside Docker context. Archive digest/length fixed; request equality and resumed request hashes bind current reviewed runner, original source version, execution ID and deadlines. No archive/source mutation.

requirements.topic: Command log and local process bound
requirements.detail: Merged stdout/stderr read incrementally and charged against shared byte cap. Excess fails the build; bounded secret capture avoids credential output. Nonblocking input and departed-leader process-group termination independently checked. Failure footer has1025-byte allowance; CodeBuild bootstrap/platform/daemon output excluded.

One StartBuild attempt saved before submission, no automatic retry; original70min deadline retained on resume; cancel at65min, at most3stop attempts, call timeouts and no CLI retry. Terminal success requires matching build, buildComplete and persisted confirmation within original window without cancellation. Ambiguous/unreachable/nonterminal state fails rather than claiming termination.

Verified actual S3 custody/version, accepted image/log byte limits and exact generated request remain coordinator inputs. No arbitrary limits or synthetic custody qualify a real attempt. This reviewer did not run prepare against actual cloud custody.

Credential input moved to nonblocking writes so small nonreading pipes cannot bypass command deadline
resolvedDuringReview.initialStatus: REVIEW_RISK_IDENTIFIED; initial normal-pipe probe was not a failing reproduction

resolvedDuringReview.description: Resume previously trusted persisted SUCCEEDED without terminal confirmation; out-of-window success also needed explicit rejection

mandatoryDesignReview.reason: One CodeBuild attempt state machine owns submission/reconciliation/observation/cancellation/terminal transition around the same state and original deadline. Transport, recipe generation, state validation, persistence and success predicates have separate owners. Injected API/clock/save tests exercise this lifecycle without unrelated subsystems; splitting only to meet line count would obscure shared invariants. Scope is intentionally one designated operator and one live supervisor.

retainedLimits: No native image build/push/scan/deployment or provider behavior was accepted.
70minutes is an enforced local observation target and nonzero failure boundary, not a guarantee AWS will terminate or a hard spending cap.
One live supervisor and durable retained state are operational prerequisites; concurrent/distributed ownership and lost-host cancellation are not implemented.
CodeBuild queue is narrowed per run from project10minutes to5minutes; runtime stays60minutes and the project itself is unchanged.
Command log bytes plus fixed footer are bounded; total CloudWatch ingestion and Docker daemon output/work are not.
AWS CLI API response size is checked after subprocess capture; this is not a streaming memory limit.
Unknown submission search examines at most20recent IDs; unreconciled identity or stop denial remains UNKNOWN_REMOTE_STATE.
Runner final describe-images is not a completed exact-digest scan gate; scan/deployment review remains separate.
